title: Hidden Lake Condos #321 | KEY.co
description_expanded: This remarkable three-bedroom, two-bathroom condo comfortably accommodates up to eight guests, making it an ideal choice for families or groups. The master bedroom is appointed with a luxurious king bed and a private bathroom, offering a serene and restful oasis. The guest bedroom features a cozy queen bed and a well-appointed hall bathroom. Additionally, a third bedroom is available, providing extra flexibility and space. Needing additional sleeping arrangements? The living area includes a convenient sleeper sofa, ensuring everyone has a comfortable spot to unwind. Discover the ultimate vacation retreat at this stunning condo. Boasting an array of enticing features, this property offers an unbeatable vacation experience. Dive into relaxation at the zero-entry pool, perfect for cooling off on those warm summer days. Stay active and energized at the on-site workout facility, ensuring you can maintain your fitness routine throughout your stay. For those who enjoy the smoky flavors of outdoor grilling, communal charcoal grills are conveniently provided, allowing you to savor delicious meals with family and friends.
